title: Instrument row
description: One instrument as GET /api/v1/instruments?venue serves it: the domain Instrument record (its trading rules) as strings, plus display fields and the 24-hour stats. The whole response is $defs/list, with a version so the panel does not refetch on every open. Mirrors src/panel/model/instruments.ts (InstrumentRow, InstrumentList). See decision 0007 part 3 decision 9.

selectorKind.description: Effective selector kind is selectorKind ?? kind; absent retains the execution classification. No producer sets it until B10.2, including TradFi migration. Old requests exclude Stocks unless selectorKinds opts in.

sizeStep.description: Exact lot step, including non-power-of-ten share lots. Absent: 10^-szDecimals.

fractionableEh.description: Venue fractional-share support outside regular hours; absent unknown.

extendedSession.description: Venue extended-session support; absent unknown, no session choice inferred.

contractType.description: Native contract type; TRADIFI_PERPETUAL selects the TradFi picker kind while arithmetic remains perpetual.

underlyingType.description: Native underlying category, when supplied by the venue.

marginAsset.description: Native margin currency; not inferred from the market name.

deliveryDate.description: Dated contract settlement time, UTC epoch milliseconds. Omitted for perpetuals.

id.description: The venue's instrument id, with the dex prefix on HIP-3 (xyz:SPCX).

quote.description: The quote asset; on perps the settlement asset of the notional.

szDecimals.description: Sizes are floored to 10^-szDecimals (a count, not money).

minNotional.description: Minimum order value in quote; "0" = none.

maxLeverage.description: Maximum leverage from venue facts; null until known, never an invented 1x.

marginModes.description: ["isolated"] on an isolated-only instrument; [] on spot.

limitBandPct.description: Added 2026-10-04 (ruling 158): the exchange refuses a limit order priced further than this percent from its reference price (Hyperliquid perpetuals: 80; venue-caps.schema.json limitBandPct). The DCA form warns of a planned order beyond it, less a 1% cushion, before Launch; the runtime refuses such a bot. Absent: no bound (spot).

priceRule.description: A price has at most sigFigs significant figures and maxDecimals decimals; an integer is always valid (Hyperliquid: 5 and 6 - szDecimals).

rungs.description: The order book's aggregation rungs (0007 part 1).

lastPrice.description: Last traded price in quote; Binance fills it while statistics are read, and Hyperliquid rows omit it. Absent/null until known. Used to value 24h volume in the base currency on display.

volume24h.description: 24-hour volume, a quote notional; null until read.

change24h.description: 24-hour change, percent; Hyperliquid mark-price change versus prevDayPx. Null until read; never an invented zero. Used by the selector column, sorts and Gainers/Losers (MH ruling 373).

caps.description: What the venue offers the form. The first order type is the venue's default, used when a carried type is not offered.

spot.description: Spot orders can be sent (true under `gcx run` since E15). When false, the form still shows Buy and Sell on a spot market and the runtime refuses the order.

spotListed.description: Spot markets are listed: the selector's Spot tab, their chart, book and trades. Optional; when absent it is the value of `spot`. Kept for compatibility; under `gcx run` it equals `spot`.

maxTimeInForce.description: The venue's longest time in force, milliseconds.

builderFee.description: Added 2026-10-26 (0037 §10 d1): our fee is taken on each order as the exchange's builder fee (Hyperliquid: true); false where the exchange has none and the fee is paid with credits. Optional; when absent it is true.

defaultMarket.description: Added 2026-11-07 (FIRST-MARKET): the instrument id the Trade page opens on when nothing is remembered for the venue or the remembered market is no longer listed (goodcryptoX's default_symbol), for example, Hyperliquid `BTC` (the main dex's BTC perpetual), Binance `binance:spot:BTCUSDT`. Optional; when absent, or not in the list, the list's first row.

feeRates.description: Added 2026-10-26 (0040 amendment d28.4): the exchange's published base maker and taker fee rates per market kind, fractions, shown until the account's own rates are read. Optional; absent where the exchange serves none.
